about: Wayne D. McGrew, III is a top-rated attorney who practices law in Atlanta, Georgia. Wayne McGrew, III focuses on Professional Liability: Defense issues. Additionally, he also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: Civil Litigation: Defense, Personal Injury - General: Defense, Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Defense and Personal Injury - Products: Defense.

Wayne McGrew, III received Super Lawyers designation for 2008 - 2027. He was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
He became a licensed attorney in 1984. Before practicing law, he attended law school at Mercer University Walter F. George School of Law and graduated in 1994.
